title: Hegseth says Europe is being ‘invaded by dangerous migrants’
content: Hegseth says Europe is being ‘invaded by dangerous migrants’ Hegseth says Europe is being ‘invaded by dangerous migrants’ US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth made a speech at a ceremony commemorating D-Day in France. He claimed that Europe is facing an ‘invasion’ by migrants with what he called ‘dangerous ideologies’, and urged European governments to take action. Published On 6 Jun 2026
